title: Gauge Cosmology and Semiclassical Gravity on the Poincare Homology Sphere S^3/I* — Reproducibility Code and Datasets (Tracks I-III)
description: Self-contained Python and arbitrary-precision mpmath verification suite, differential-geometry and spectral oracles, deterministic JSON reference datasets, automated smoke tests, and publication figure generators reproducing every theorem, numerical table, and figure across the three companion papers on classical, non-Abelian SU(2)_L Yang-Mills-Higgs, and semiclassical Starobinsky-Casimir / covariant Riegert-Weyl cosmology on the Poincare homology sphere S^3/I* and spherical space forms S^3/Gamma.
